text_block_list.text:
Wanting to provide a stage worthy of 
Daiichi Ruby, the Trainer formulates a 
plan to heavily promote the Mile 
Championship.

To demonstrate the present brilliance of 
the "Noble Clan"— the Trainer declared 
that dedicating themselves to making her 
dream come true was their true mission.

They also invite Daiichi Ruby's parents. 
Her Trainer gives their full endorsement 
that she is now worthy of showing what it 
means to be part of the family.

Furthermore, negotiations with the 
"Illustrious Family" secured their promise 
to spectate the race. With heightened 
attention, the race's prestige would rise 
as well.

Steadily preparing for the Mile CS, the 
Trainer works behind the scenes. The 
ultimate stage is nearing completion—
